name: camayoc_metrics_for_subject
description: Q1: metrics catalogued for a service or component, including meaning and owner.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?metric ?label ?meaning ?owner WHERE { ?requirement a aegis:NonFunctionalRequirement ; aegis:about <{subject}> . ?metric a aegis:Metric ; aegis:measuresRequirement ?requirement ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:meaning ?meaning ; aegis:ownedBy ?owner . } ORDER BY ?label
